items.caption:
Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM) flashcards, quiz and mind map from one article: real walkthrough
Stop making flashcards by hand. Google made me 60 from one article 📚

It's Gemini Notebook (the new name of NotebookLM), free at notebook.google.com:
1. New notebook, then Add sources: paste a link, upload a PDF or a YouTube video
2. In the Studio panel, tap Flashcards (there are 9 tools: Flashcards, Quiz, Mind Map, Audio Overview, Video Overview, Slide Deck, Infographic, Reports, Data Table)
3. Pro tip: type your focus in "What should the topic be?" (like "help me study for my biology exam")
4. Quiz: pick Hard and mix question types like Fill in the Blank

From ONE Wikipedia page I got 60 flashcards, a 12-question hard quiz and a mind map.

Free with a Google account (there's a usage limit). AI can make mistakes, so double-check facts.

Comment NOTES and I'll DM you my 5 best study prompts.
Send this to a friend with an exam coming up.

The screens in the video are our own animated recreation of the app.

Made with an AI voice and AI visuals.

#aitools #studytips #productivity #googletips
items.first_comment: Try it with your class notes: upload the PDF, then make a Hard quiz with Fill in the Blank questions the night before the test.
